ShortDescription.Value: A cheat mod that keeps your city budget positive with configurable automatic boosts.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Budget Booster
A cheat mod that keeps your city budget positive, so you can build without watching the bank balance.
This is a cheat mod. If managing your city's finances is the part of the game you enjoy, it is not for you. If you would rather spend your time designing, it takes care of the money.
## Boost modes
Pick how the mod tops you up in Options / Mods / Budget Booster.
- Auto-Balance: adds money only when your balance drops below a target you set. It adds enough to get back to the target plus your Boost Amount, up to the per-cycle cap. It works as a safety net, not infinite cash. - Fixed Boost: adds a set amount every cycle, a steady income for creative building. - Percentage: reads what your city spends per day from the game's budget system and pays back a share of it, spread across the day. At 25%, a city spending $1M a day gets about $250K a day, so the boost grows as your city does.
When the game's own Unlimited Money option is on, the mod does nothing.
## Quick presets
Each preset sets several options in one click. Its tooltip lists exactly which ones and to what.
- Casual Builder: Auto-Balance to a $100K target plus $250K. Light help that still leaves some challenge. - Sandbox Mode: $5M Fixed Boost every 64 ticks, for building without limits. - Growing City: Percentage mode at 25% of daily expenses. Scales with the city, so there is less to adjust. - Emergency Only: Auto-Balance to $0 plus $50K. A safety net against bankruptcy and nothing more.
## Settings
The in-game options menu has sliders for boost amount, target surplus, boost percentage, a maximum per cycle safety cap, and how often the mod checks. Options that do not apply to your chosen mode are hidden.
## Session statistics
Shows boosts applied, total money added, your last boost, and current balance. Counters cover the current session and reset when you restart the game.
## Notifications
You can turn them off, or pick a level: minimal (only large boosts), normal, or detailed (adds balance and running totals).
## Diagnostics
The Debug section has detailed logging and a **Run Diagnostics** button. The button writes a report to the log right away: the mod version, any load errors, your settings and session statistics. Your city's balance, expenses and which Percentage path is in use follow once a city is loaded and unpaused. If something looks wrong, check that report first. It is also the most useful thing to attach to a bug report.
## Compatibility
- Works on existing saves. You can install or remove it at any time. - Removing the mod leaves your money alone, and your save stays compatible with the base game. - May conflict with other mods that change the economy or write to the city's money.
## Bugs and feedback
Report issues on GitHub with your game version, the mod version, the output of **Run Diagnostics**, and steps to reproduce.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Percentage mode now pays the share of your city's daily expenses you chose, spread across the day. Before this it paid that share of a whole day's expenses every cycle, about 1,000 times too much at the default interval. If you use Percentage mode, expect much smaller boosts. Raise Boost Percentage if you want more. - Boosts near the $2 billion ceiling now count only the money actually added, and the balance can no longer wrap around to minus $2 billion. - With the game's Unlimited Money option on, the mod now stays idle instead of misreading your balance. - Run Diagnostics now writes the mod version, load errors, settings and statistics straight away. Your city's balance, expenses and which Percentage path is in use follow once a city is loaded and unpaused. Reload Boost Logic no longer waits for the mod to be enabled. - Log Boost Cycles (now Log Applied Boosts) only logs cycles that add money. It used to write two lines every cycle and could grow the log to many megabytes. - Preset tooltips now list every setting each preset changes.
